members.name: ScreenPointToRay
members.signature: public static Ray ScreenPointToRay(Float2 screenPosition, Float4x4 viewMatrix, Float4x4 projectionMatrix, float viewportWidth, float viewportHeight)

docs.summary: Creates a ray from a 2D screen position, camera matrices, and viewport dimensions. This ray can be used for picking objects in the 3D world. Assumes DirectX-style projection (depth 0-1).
docs.returns: A Ray originating from the near plane and pointing into the scene.

params.screenPosition: The 2D screen coordinates (e.g., mouse position). Y is typically 0 at top.
params.viewportWidth: The width of the viewport in pixels.
params.viewportHeight: The height of the viewport in pixels.

members.name: ScreenPointToRayFromCamera
members.signature: public static Ray ScreenPointToRayFromCamera(Float2 screenPosition, Float3 cameraWorldPosition, Float4x4 viewMatrix, Float4x4 projectionMatrix, float viewportWidth, float viewportHeight)

docs.summary: Creates a ray from a 2D screen position using camera properties. The ray originates from the camera's world position. Assumes DirectX-style projection (depth 0-1).
docs.returns: A Ray starting from the camera's world position.

params.screenPosition: The 2D screen coordinates (Y typically 0 at top).
params.cameraWorldPosition: The world position of the camera.
